   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Jul 18, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _L_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "those who say that the messages are unlimited for free are paid for reviews/ written before it started to be paid for. you have a limit, then you have to pay. the characters' answers don't make sense, they're illogical and stupid. plus I've spent all my free messages at fixing bugs - each time I log into the app there is different answer chosen, not the one I picked, and it affects the entire conversation. I scroll through answers for an hour just to discover a few messages above there's a bug."
            2. _Zug anator_, Aug 1, 2026, 2/5: "The app was phenomenal, but has its quirks. I was willing to deal with those.But now my private chats and the private characters I created the videos that I spent the diamonds on have mysteriously disappeared, and it doesn't seem like they're going to fix it on top of that. They want me to spend more diamonds to get the videos back. Basically make me waste money. This app is becoming more and more jinky, and glitchy. i'll adjust my reading if they ever fix this stuff or ever get back to me."
            3. _Nicholas Scott_, Aug 2, 2026, 3/5: "you can do so much with the free account. it pretty much rules. I would give 5 stars but I can't find a way to contact the admin in the app and the link to discord is broken and doesn't work. I just want to report that 100 gem stones somehow got accidentally spent on energy which I have an abundance of and gems are hard to come by without spending money."
